title: Office printers crash on PDFs
description: Shared office printers stop responding whenever someone prints a PDF from Edge.
note: Office printers on firmware 4.1 hang when Edge sends a PDF with embedded fonts; firmware 4.2 fixes it, and printing from Acrobat avoids it until then.

title: Marketing site hero image blurry
description: The hero banner looks low resolution on recent iPhones.
note: Since the March cost cut the image CDN serves /hero images at quality 40; setting quality to 85 in the CDN rule for /hero restores them.

title: VPN drops remote staff every half hour
description: Remote staff lose the VPN connection about every 30 minutes and have to reconnect.
note: The VPN concentrator drops sessions after 30 minutes because its DPD timeout was set to 1800 seconds in March; raising dpd_timeout to 3600 fixes the drops.
